title: BT41012: Downstream Processing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction; An overview of bioseparation. Separation of cells and other
insolubles from fermented broth. Filtration and microfiltration, centrifugation
(batch, continuous, basket). Cell disruption: Physical methods (osmotic shock,
grinding with abrasives, solid shear, liquid shear), Chemical methods (alkali,
detergents), Enzymatic methods Products isolation: Extraction and adsorption
method, precipitation (ammonium sulphate. Organic solvents, high molecular
weight polymers), column chromatography; ultrafiltration., Products polishing:
Crystallization and drying.
